# BatteryBoost for Realme GT Neo 5 SE (RMX3700 / RMX3701)

--- ## ⚡ Overview **BatteryBoost** is a surgical power-optimization, scheduler-tuning, and telemetry-suppression module built specifically for **Realme GT Neo 5 SE** (`RMX3700`, `RMX3701`, `RE585F`, `RE58D1L1` / `senna_jr`). Unlike generic battery modules that blindfold governors or throttle devices into stuttering, **BatteryBoost v3.0 is built on empirical live measurements** on stock firmware (`16.0.5.1010(EX01)`). Every single value was tested before and after: * **238 parameters applied** (237 OK, 0 critical failures). * **Work with vendor strengths**: Stock UFS auto-hibernation, clock-gating, Wi-Fi sleep, and suspend are already optimal and left untouched. * **Neutralize vendor bugs**: Subsystem memory dumpers, aggressive wakeups on touch, continuous telemetry spam, and GPU sleep blocks are eliminated at the root. --- ## 📊 Live Device Measurements & Telemetry | Metric / Scenario | Stock Behavior | BatteryBoost v3.0 | Real-World Impact | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Deep Sleep Drain** | 2–3% / 8 hours (sporadic wakeups) | **5% over 18 hours** | **~0.27%/hour** idle drain | | **Idle Sleep Current** | Spikes up to 180–300 mA | **6 – 53 mA** steady | Ultra-low standby draw | | **Memory Buses (DDR / LLCC / L3)** | Frequent unneeded escalations | Rock-solid minimum clock in idle | Saves significant SoC base power | | **Touch Input Reaction** | Wakes Prime core (`cpu7`) to **1996 MHz** | Wakes only Silver & Gold (`cpu0-6`) | Zero touch jank, no Prime spikes | | **Audio Offload Buffer** | 32 KB (wakes CPU every ~100ms) | **256 KB** (8x buffer capacity) | **8x fewer CPU wakeups** during music | | **OPlus Telemetry** | `ostatsd`, `pullerd`, `tpd`, `midasd` active | **All 5 daemons neutralized via vendor trigger** | Zero background analytics overhead | | **GPU Sleep (`force_no_nap`)** | Stuck at `1` (GPU prevented from nap) | **Enforced `0` with recovery daemon** | Adreno 725 collapses into low-power states | | **CPU Throttling Test** | ~289 GIPS (dips sharply upon heating) | **289 max / 274 avg / 241 min GIPS** | Sustained throughput without thermal crash | --- ## 🧠 Key Features & Architectural Highlights ### 1. SmartBoost: Screen-Gated Adaptive Load Engine Previous versions used blunt caps or unbounded triggers. **SmartBoost v3.0** introduces a precise, dual-window load detector: * **Dual Metrics:** * **GPU Busy Ratio:** Evaluates `gpubusy` delta over 15-second windows (triggers at $\ge 20\%$). * **Big Cluster CPU Utilization:** Reads `/proc/stat` delta across cores `cpu4–7` (triggers at $\ge 70\%$). * **Screen State Gating (`mWakefulness`):** Detects panel state directly from the Android power subsystem. If the screen is Off or in AOD (`Asleep`/`Dozing`), SmartBoost is strictly locked to battery mode. Background GPU rendering will **never** trigger clock boosts. * **Single-Tier Prime Release:** * Under heavy load, only the **Prime Cortex-X2** core is released to **2918.4 MHz**. * The Gold cluster remains capped at **2112.0 MHz**. > *Empirically proven:* Uncapping both Gold and Prime simultaneously caused fast thermal accumulation, triggering Qualcomm's aggressive thermal engine and resulting in *lower* sustained GIPS (259 vs 289 GIPS). ### 2. OPlus Telemetry Neutralization (Root Level) Stock OPlus ROMs spawn multiple telemetry and diagnostic loggers that wake the device repeatedly: * **The Root Fix:** Rather than waging an endless daemon kill-loop, BatteryBoost flips the internal vendor trigger via `persist.sys.midas_ostats.restriction=1`. * Completely stops and disables: * `ostatsd` (CPU analytics) * `ostats_pullerd` * `ostats_tpd` * `midasd` * `vendor.ss_ramdump` (subsystem ramdump collection) * **Bluetooth HCI Logging:** Disabled (`persist.sys.oplus.bt.cache_hcilog_mode=0`), stopping up to 100 MB of diagnostic dumps writing to internal flash. * **Doze Lockdown:** Stripped `com.heytap.pictorial` (lockscreen wallpaper downloader) from the system Doze whitelist. ### 3. CPU, WALT & Scheduler Refinements * **Silver (Cortex-A510):** `adaptive_low_freq` synced with hardware floor (300 MHz), hispeed frequency capped at 940.8 MHz, target load increased to 85. * **Gold (Cortex-A715):** Steady-state max frequency capped to 2112 MHz (saving noticeable power vs stock 2496 MHz peak while preserving fluidity). Core activation threshold raised to 4 concurrent tasks. * **Prime (Cortex-X2):** Steady-state cap set to 2361.6 MHz (stock idle drifted up to 2707 MHz). Releases to 2918.4 MHz only when SmartBoost detects sustained heavy workloads. * **WALT Conservative Forecasting:** `sched_conservative_pl=1` prevents transient micro-tasks from spiking CPU clusters into high-frequency steps. ### 4. Background Guardian Daemons * **Fast Daemon (15s):** Guards GPU nap, Core Control thresholds, clamp values, Input Boost frequencies, and SmartBoost state transitions against vendor ORMS resets. * **Slow Daemon (120s):** Periodic surveillance over DDR/LLCC bus parameters, swappiness, and persistent vendor telemetry revive checks. * **NAP0 Daemon:** First 3 minutes of boot, verifies `force_no_nap=0` every 10 seconds. * **IRQ Daemon:** Automatically redirects WiFi interrupts (`pci0_wlan_ce_*`, `wlan_wake_irq`) to energy-efficient Silver cores (`0f`). ### 5. Non-Intrusive `[BATT]` Sampler Integrated directly into the survival daemon log. Every 60 seconds, it appends a compact health status: ```text [BATT] up=12450s cap=87 cur=-142000 temp=310 gold=1440000/2112000 prime=787200 boost=0 ``` Allows real-time verification of charging, discharging current ($\mu A$), thermal state, and active frequencies without third-party battery drainers. --- ## 🧹 What Was Removed in v3.0 (Anti-Battery & Dead Code) | Tweak / Parameter | Previous State | v3.0 Status | Reason | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `tcp_keepalive_time` | Lowered to 1800s | **Removed (Stock 7200s)** | Lowering keepalive woke cellular/Wi-Fi radio 4x more often in standby. | | `sched_pelt_multiplier` | Set to 4 | **Removed (Stock 1)** | Forced Silver cores to 1804.8 MHz during simple video playback. | | `sched_many_wakeup_threshold` | Set to 3 | **Removed** | Scattered wakeups across unrelated cores instead of packing. | | `sched_group_downmigrate` | Set to 85 | **Removed** | Kept task groups pinned to power-hungry Big cores too long. | | `Silver scaling_min` | Forced to 300 MHz | **Removed** | Vendor perf engine continuously rejected it, causing CPU churn. | | UFS Storage Tunables | Re-writing hibern8/clkgate | **Removed** | Stock EX01 already defaults to `5000/1/1`; previous code was redundant. | | Display No-Ops | Overwriting VRR/QSync props | **Removed** | Stock firmware already handles these properly. | --- ## 🛠️ Installation & Updating > [!WARNING] > **Dirty updates over v2.x are NOT supported.** Old configurations, legacy scripts, or lingering bind-mounts can interfere with v3.0's architecture. ### Clean Installation Procedure: 1. **Remove** previous BatteryBoost module in KernelSU / Magisk / APatch. 2. **Reboot** the device. 3. **Flash** `BatteryBoost_GTNeo5SE_v3.0.zip`. 4. **Reboot** and allow the system 3–4 minutes to settle. ### Clean Uninstall: Disable or remove the module via your root manager and reboot. The included `uninstall.sh` automatically restores all `persist.*` properties, re-whitelists stock Doze services, and purges logs. --- ## 🔍 Verification & Diagnostics To check the operational log on your phone via Termux or ADB: ```bash su -c "cat /data/local/tmp/batteryboost.log" ``` To live-monitor SmartBoost and power transitions: ```bash su -c "tail -f /data/local/tmp/batteryboost.log | grep -E 'SmartBoost|BATT|Fixed'" ``` --- ## 👤 Author & Acknowledgments * **Developer:** [ZhilkaD](https://github.com/ZhilkaD) * **Target Device:** Realme GT Neo 5 SE (`RMX3700` / `RMX3701` / `RE585F`)

BatteryBoost for Realme GT Neo 5 SE (RMX3700 / RMX3701)

---

⚡ Overview

BatteryBoost is a surgical power-optimization, scheduler-tuning, and telemetry-suppression module built specifically for Realme GT Neo 5 SE (RMX3700, RMX3701, RE585F, RE58D1L1 / senna_jr).

Unlike generic battery modules that blindfold governors or throttle devices into stuttering, BatteryBoost v3.0 is built on empirical live measurements on stock firmware (16.0.5.1010(EX01)). Every single value was tested before and after:

  • **238 parameters applied** (237 OK, 0 critical failures).
  • **Work with vendor strengths**: Stock UFS auto-hibernation, clock-gating, Wi-Fi sleep, and suspend are already optimal and left untouched.
  • **Neutralize vendor bugs**: Subsystem memory dumpers, aggressive wakeups on touch, continuous telemetry spam, and GPU sleep blocks are eliminated at the root.

    • ---

    📊 Live Device Measurements & Telemetry

    | Metric / Scenario | Stock Behavior | BatteryBoost v3.0 | Real-World Impact |

    | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

    | Deep Sleep Drain | 2–3% / 8 hours (sporadic wakeups) | 5% over 18 hours | ~0.27%/hour idle drain |

    | Idle Sleep Current | Spikes up to 180–300 mA | 6 – 53 mA steady | Ultra-low standby draw |

    | Memory Buses (DDR / LLCC / L3) | Frequent unneeded escalations | Rock-solid minimum clock in idle | Saves significant SoC base power |

    | Touch Input Reaction | Wakes Prime core (cpu7) to 1996 MHz | Wakes only Silver & Gold (cpu0-6) | Zero touch jank, no Prime spikes |

    | Audio Offload Buffer | 32 KB (wakes CPU every ~100ms) | 256 KB (8x buffer capacity) | 8x fewer CPU wakeups during music |

    | OPlus Telemetry | ostatsd, pullerd, tpd, midasd active | All 5 daemons neutralized via vendor trigger | Zero background analytics overhead |

    | GPU Sleep (force_no_nap) | Stuck at 1 (GPU prevented from nap) | Enforced 0 with recovery daemon | Adreno 725 collapses into low-power states |

    | CPU Throttling Test | ~289 GIPS (dips sharply upon heating) | 289 max / 274 avg / 241 min GIPS | Sustained throughput without thermal crash |

    ---

    🧠 Key Features & Architectural Highlights

    1. SmartBoost: Screen-Gated Adaptive Load Engine

    Previous versions used blunt caps or unbounded triggers. SmartBoost v3.0 introduces a precise, dual-window load detector:

  • **Dual Metrics:**

    • * GPU Busy Ratio: Evaluates gpubusy delta over 15-second windows (triggers at $\ge 20\%$).

    * Big Cluster CPU Utilization: Reads /proc/stat delta across cores cpu4–7 (triggers at $\ge 70\%$).

  • **Screen State Gating (`mWakefulness`):** Detects panel state directly from the Android power subsystem. If the screen is Off or in AOD (`Asleep`/`Dozing`), SmartBoost is strictly locked to battery mode. Background GPU rendering will **never** trigger clock boosts.
  • **Single-Tier Prime Release:**

    • * Under heavy load, only the Prime Cortex-X2 core is released to 2918.4 MHz.

    * The Gold cluster remains capped at 2112.0 MHz.

    > *Empirically proven:* Uncapping both Gold and Prime simultaneously caused fast thermal accumulation, triggering Qualcomm's aggressive thermal engine and resulting in *lower* sustained GIPS (259 vs 289 GIPS).

    2. OPlus Telemetry Neutralization (Root Level)

    Stock OPlus ROMs spawn multiple telemetry and diagnostic loggers that wake the device repeatedly:

  • **The Root Fix:** Rather than waging an endless daemon kill-loop, BatteryBoost flips the internal vendor trigger via `persist.sys.midas_ostats.restriction=1`.
  • Completely stops and disables:

    • * ostatsd (CPU analytics)

    * ostats_pullerd

    * ostats_tpd

    * midasd

    * vendor.ss_ramdump (subsystem ramdump collection)

  • **Bluetooth HCI Logging:** Disabled (`persist.sys.oplus.bt.cache_hcilog_mode=0`), stopping up to 100 MB of diagnostic dumps writing to internal flash.
  • **Doze Lockdown:** Stripped `com.heytap.pictorial` (lockscreen wallpaper downloader) from the system Doze whitelist.

    • 3. CPU, WALT & Scheduler Refinements

  • **Silver (Cortex-A510):** `adaptive_low_freq` synced with hardware floor (300 MHz), hispeed frequency capped at 940.8 MHz, target load increased to 85.
  • **Gold (Cortex-A715):** Steady-state max frequency capped to 2112 MHz (saving noticeable power vs stock 2496 MHz peak while preserving fluidity). Core activation threshold raised to 4 concurrent tasks.
  • **Prime (Cortex-X2):** Steady-state cap set to 2361.6 MHz (stock idle drifted up to 2707 MHz). Releases to 2918.4 MHz only when SmartBoost detects sustained heavy workloads.
  • **WALT Conservative Forecasting:** `sched_conservative_pl=1` prevents transient micro-tasks from spiking CPU clusters into high-frequency steps.

    • 4. Background Guardian Daemons

  • **Fast Daemon (15s):** Guards GPU nap, Core Control thresholds, clamp values, Input Boost frequencies, and SmartBoost state transitions against vendor ORMS resets.
  • **Slow Daemon (120s):** Periodic surveillance over DDR/LLCC bus parameters, swappiness, and persistent vendor telemetry revive checks.
  • **NAP0 Daemon:** First 3 minutes of boot, verifies `force_no_nap=0` every 10 seconds.
  • **IRQ Daemon:** Automatically redirects WiFi interrupts (`pci0_wlan_ce_*`, `wlan_wake_irq`) to energy-efficient Silver cores (`0f`).

    • 5. Non-Intrusive `[BATT]` Sampler

    Integrated directly into the survival daemon log. Every 60 seconds, it appends a compact health status:

    [BATT] up=12450s cap=87 cur=-142000 temp=310 gold=1440000/2112000 prime=787200 boost=0

    Allows real-time verification of charging, discharging current ($\mu A$), thermal state, and active frequencies without third-party battery drainers.

    ---

    🧹 What Was Removed in v3.0 (Anti-Battery & Dead Code)

    | Tweak / Parameter | Previous State | v3.0 Status | Reason |

    | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

    | tcp_keepalive_time | Lowered to 1800s | Removed (Stock 7200s) | Lowering keepalive woke cellular/Wi-Fi radio 4x more often in standby. |

    | sched_pelt_multiplier | Set to 4 | Removed (Stock 1) | Forced Silver cores to 1804.8 MHz during simple video playback. |

    | sched_many_wakeup_threshold | Set to 3 | Removed | Scattered wakeups across unrelated cores instead of packing. |

    | sched_group_downmigrate | Set to 85 | Removed | Kept task groups pinned to power-hungry Big cores too long. |

    | Silver scaling_min | Forced to 300 MHz | Removed | Vendor perf engine continuously rejected it, causing CPU churn. |

    | UFS Storage Tunables | Re-writing hibern8/clkgate | Removed | Stock EX01 already defaults to 5000/1/1; previous code was redundant. |

    | Display No-Ops | Overwriting VRR/QSync props | Removed | Stock firmware already handles these properly. |

    ---

    🛠️ Installation & Updating

    > [!WARNING]

    > Dirty updates over v2.x are NOT supported. Old configurations, legacy scripts, or lingering bind-mounts can interfere with v3.0's architecture.

    Clean Installation Procedure:

  • **Remove** previous BatteryBoost module in KernelSU / Magisk / APatch.
  • **Reboot** the device.
  • **Flash** `BatteryBoost_GTNeo5SE_v3.0.zip`.
  • **Reboot** and allow the system 3–4 minutes to settle.

    • Clean Uninstall:

    Disable or remove the module via your root manager and reboot. The included uninstall.sh automatically restores all persist.* properties, re-whitelists stock Doze services, and purges logs.

    ---

    🔍 Verification & Diagnostics

    To check the operational log on your phone via Termux or ADB:

    su -c "cat /data/local/tmp/batteryboost.log"

    To live-monitor SmartBoost and power transitions:

    su -c "tail -f /data/local/tmp/batteryboost.log | grep -E 'SmartBoost|BATT|Fixed'"

    ---

    👤 Author & Acknowledgments

  • **Developer:** [ZhilkaD](https://github.com/ZhilkaD)
  • **Target Device:** Realme GT Neo 5 SE (`RMX3700` / `RMX3701` / `RE585F`)
